source: Her Vitals (women's life-stage health) plan — perimenopause-stack 49k hub + niche-attack-supplements-2026-05-29

clusters: 6 life-stage pillars (TTC/pregnancy -> postnatal -> perimenopause [anchor] -> menopause -> senior + cross-stage /symptoms/) — audience entry, each routes to the right SKU recommendation
6 cross-stage SKU pillars (protein, creatine, pre-workout, magnesium, collagen, ashwagandha/ayurveda) — the conversion engines; each serves multiple life stages with per-page positioning
Find-your-stack quiz engine — 10Q, email-gated, life-stage-aware affiliate routing to a curated 3-5 product stack
/research/ data moat — quarterly heavy-metals lab + annual UK perimenopause survey + EFSA register guide = the citation reference URLs
authority_pillars: Named RD (AfN) + menopause-specialist GP (BMS, not Newson) + Level-4 strength coach E-E-A-T
Quarterly heavy-metals lab report on 10 popular UK brands
EFSA-claim anchored, brand-neutral, reviewedBy schema on every page

slot_rules.Life-stage pillar: Hub page for an audience life stage; 40-60w answer capsule + symptom/decision spokes + routes into cross-stage SKU pillars + ends with a curated affiliate pick. Each expands to 6-20 spokes by month 12.
slot_rules.SKU pillar: Cross-stage supplement-category hub; benefits/dose/safety/comparison spokes + per-life-stage positioning pages + a /reviews/ best-X output. Each expands to 10-30 spokes; AIO firing across the cluster.
slot_rules.Review: Best-X-UK affiliate output page recommending 3-5 EXISTING branded products (Amazon Associates + Awin + direct programs); named-clinician reviewedBy + lab data where applicable. ~25-40 review pages at maturity.
slot_rules.Quiz: find-your-stack engine + per-life-stage output variants + the two perimenopause-test capture pages; email-gated, routes to affiliate-linked stack.
slot_rules.Research: First-party citable data + methodology (heavy-metals lab, UK survey, EFSA guide, testing rubric, exclusion criteria). The strongest AI-citation signals.
slot_rules.Trust: Named-team Person-schema /about/ pages (RD/GP/coach/ayurvedic + process) and the glossary DefinedTerm set — the E-E-A-T entity moat.
